ommc.gui.title.configs: Oh My Minecraft Client - Config - Version: %s
config.comment.clearwaypoint: A hotkey to clear the highlighted waypoint.
config.comment.forceparsewaypointfromcha: Force parsing waypoints from chat, overriding any existing click event.
config.comment.dontclearchathistory: Save the chat messages to a file when leaving a world, and restore them the next time you join the same world. Saved separately per world (save / server), so histories never mix. Note: only the messages are saved, not the input history (the ones you scroll through with the up arrow).
config.comment.disableblocklistcheck: Workaround for MC-218167: keep the network request from blocking the render thread.
config.comment.disablepistonpushentity: Reduce piston lag (e.g. carpet duplicators) by preventing client-side pistons from pushing entities (except the player). May cause entity position rendering errors.
config.comment.highlightpersistentmob: Highlight mobs that will not despawn. Limited by client-side data: currently only mobs holding special items or with custom names can be detected.
config.comment.highlightpersistentmobcli: Use client-side data (held item, custom name) to decide whether a mob will despawn. May misjudge. Keep this off in singleplayer; on servers MasaGadget's syncAllEntityData can be used to sync entity data locally.
config.comment.worldeaterminehelper: When blocks listed in the World Eater Mine Helper Whitelist are exposed to air, the client renders a mirror image of them above, to help with world eater maintenance and mining.
config.comment.highlightentityblacklist: Blacklist for the entity highlight feature.
config.comment.highlightentitylisttype: Whether highlightEntityWhiteList/BlackList is treated as a whitelist or a blacklist.
config.comment.highlightentitywhitelist: Whitelist for the entity highlight feature.
config.comment.worldeaterminehelperwhite: Blocks that get the mirrored render while worldEaterMineHelper is enabled.
config.comment.blockmodelnooffsetblackli: Blacklist for the block model no-offset feature.
config.comment.blockmodelnooffsetlisttyp: Whether blockModelNoOffsetWhitelist/Blacklist is treated as a whitelist or a blacklist.
config.comment.blockmodelnooffsetwhiteli: Whitelist for the block model no-offset feature.
config.comment.highlightbeamtime: How long (in seconds) the beam of the highlighted waypoint stays visible. 0 means no beam, only the icon and text.
config.comment.openconfiggui: A hotkey to open the in-game Config GUI
config.comment.sendlookingatblockpos: A hotkey to send looking at pos.
config.comment.sortinventorysupportempty: Support empty shulker box stack when sort inventory.
config.comment.bettersneaking: Player can move down 1 height when sneaking.
config.comment.disablebreakscaffolding: You can only break scaffolding with the items in §6breakScaffoldingWhiteList§r.
config.comment.disablemovedowninscaffold: You can only move down scaffolding with the items inside §6moveDownInScaffoldingWhiteList§r in your hand.
config.comment.flatdigger: Which allowed you mine a flat road while digging stone by preventing digging of blocks under your feet while standing，sneak to dig blocks under you.
config.comment.forcebreakingcooldown: You will have 5gt cooldown after instant breaking.
config.comment.preventintentionalgamedes: Prevent Intentional Game Design (Bed and Respawn Anchor).
config.comment.preventwastageofwater: Prevent water bucket from vanishing in nether.
config.comment.realsneaking: You cannot ascend or descend non-full blocks when sneaking, e.g. carpets.
config.comment.removebreakingcooldown: Remove cooldown after break block (default is 5gt), it will not work when enable §6forceBreakingCooldown§r.
config.comment.breakblockblacklist: If §6disableBreakScaffolding§r is enabled, you can't break blocks in §6breakBlockBlackList§r.
config.comment.breakscaffoldingwhitelist: If §6disableBreakScaffolding§r is enabled, you can only break scaffolding with the items in §6breakScaffoldingWhiteList§r.
config.comment.movedowninscaffoldingwhit: If §6disableMoveDownInScaffolding§r is enabled, you can only move down scaffolding with the items inside §6moveDownInScaffoldingWhiteList§r in your hand.
config.comment.flight: Allow flight in the integrated server.
config.comment.onlinemode: Enable online mode (Mojang authentication) for the integrated server.
config.comment.port: LAN port of the integrated server. 0 means a random port.
config.comment.pvp: Enable PVP in the integrated server.
